replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Geometric, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

the quality of the map, the size, & it's concept
it looks rushed and fairly basic, moreover, gameplay would be boring as it doesn't have much to offer that other maps don't already

You may resubmit once your map has been edited.
